text:
anya: Quick design check — attaching a small GIF of the new notification row density + SR announce flow. wondering if the compact row will break keyboard focus order and what we should announce first for screen readers. gif: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/notify-row-dense.gif mike: Nice — first impression: the bold channel label grabs too much visual weight in the compact mode, pushes the severity chip off visual scan. could we reduce weight and rely on color + icon? leah: Agree on weight. Also for SR: we should announce severity before channel name so people hear "Critical — Database Alerts — muted" rather than waiting for the name. ordering matters when rows are dense. jordan: +1. If we announce severity first it maps better to mental model. Suggest: "{severity}, {channel name}, {active / muted}, {preview count}". keeps the actionable bits up front. ben: Quick accessibility nit: avoid saying "muted" alone — prefer "notifications muted" so it's a verb phrase. small change but clearer. anya: Good call. Also UX question: do we keep the preview text in compact mode? it adds noise. maybe show preview only on hover/focus or provide a toggle in prefs. mike: I like hide-by-default. We could expose a chevron to expand preview inline. In compact state keep a one-line ellipsized preview only when space allows. leah: For keyboard users we must ensure the expand control is reachable via tab and has a descriptive aria-label like "toggle message preview for {channel}". ux-bot: Accessibility suggestion (auto-generated): consider using aria-live="polite" for preview updates and aria-atomic="true" for compound announcements. Example snippet: ```html
...row content...
``` jordan: That snippet looks good but careful: aria-live on a row that receives focus sometimes causes redundant speech in some screen readers. maybe only set aria-live on the preview region, not the entire row. ben: Good point. So plan: keep the row static for focus; when preview expands, write preview text to an aria-live container that's offscreen but accessible to SR. That minimizes chatter. anya: Sounds like a plan. One more copy tweak: change "Snooze" tooltip to "Snooze notifications for this channel" and adjust short label to "Snooze" only. avoids ambiguity. mike: +emoji :thumbsup: Also consider reducing icon sizes by 1px in compact to improve line-length for channel name. leah: Accessibility checklist for implementation: 1) announce severity first 2) use verb phrase for state ("notifications muted") 3) preview text announced via aria-live container on expand 4) keyboard focus order: expand toggle before overflow menu 5) test with VoiceOver + NVDA on dense rows. anya: Great checklist. I'll update the Figma and create a small prototype for testing. tagging @jordan and @ben for implementation pairing next week. ux-bot: Reminder: design prototype pushed to /figma/NotifyRow/compact-v3 (build id: 2026-03-20-08). jordan: I'll pair on Friday. can someone add the acceptance criteria to the ticket: announce order, aria-live behavior, keyboard order, copy strings for tooltip and SR. anya: Added to the ticket (#INF-1284). thanks everyone — will follow up with a short usability script for SR testing.
